name: io.github.inotakeh/symbol
description: Read-only MCP server for the Symbol blockchain (XYM): node health, harvesting, voting keys.

environmentVariables.name: SYMBOL_NODE_URL
environmentVariables.description: REST URL of the Symbol node to query, e.g. https://<node-host>:3001; https:// is required (http:// only for localhost / 127.0.0.1) and the port is used exactly as given.

environmentVariables.name: SYMBOL_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: mainnet or testnet; when set, start-up fails if the node reports a different network.

environmentVariables.name: SYMBOL_TIMEZONE
environmentVariables.description: IANA zone such as Asia/Tokyo that adds a local time next to every UTC timestamp.

environmentVariables.name: SYMBOL_REFERENCE_NODES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated https:// node URLs that symbol_network_compare and symbol_version_drift check against; no other host is ever contacted.

environmentVariables.name: SYMBOL_STATE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Absolute directory where symbol_harvester_watch keeps one snapshot file per node (unlocked harvester public keys, heights and times; no secrets), created on first save with mode 0700; when unset, the tool reports the current list without a comparison.
